section.title: Beyond Horizons 30-Hour Challenge: source notes
section.paragraph: This folder contains structured Markdown transcriptions of the three supplied PDFs. The notes preserve the source wording and requirements while organizing them for reliable AI retrieval.

list.item: Challenge overview and domain rules - challenge purpose, four domains, participation stages, prizes, judging criteria, and useful reading.
Judging rubric - all six weighted criteria, score descriptions, score caps, tie-breakers, and judge prompts.
Updated agenda - event schedule as shown in the agenda PDF.
The agenda PDF does not state AM/PM, a calendar date, or a time zone. Times are reproduced as printed; do not infer these details.
The challenge invitation names three useful readings but supplies no URLs, publication dates, or full bibliographic details.

The rubric's table has merged/shared row cells. Its score-level meaning is represented in explicit criterion-by-criterion lists; the source's global score mapping and special caps are stated separately.
